notes.title: A little bug!!!
notes.content:
A little bug!!!
Dewaii DNA makes Sion invisible! if Dewaii is the first Paracreat in your Team.
This Problem will be fixed in the next update.

If you have this problem go to your inventory - Paracreat - and make sure that Dewaii is not the first Paracreat in your party.

Have a nice Day!
